description: This PHP script manages test plans in the TestLink open-source test management tool. It handles operations like creating, updating, deleting test plans, uploading files, managing custom fields, and rendering the user interface for test plan management.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class managing test plan data operations, such as create, update, delete, and retrieval of test plan related information.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class for managing test project data within TestLink.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters and session data into an object for further processing.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the rights to create or manage test plans within a specified test project.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the graphical user interface parameters and loads data necessary for rendering the test plan management page.

methods.name: getItemData
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific test plan by ID and populates the GUI and editor components with this information.
